meeting.title: Sylvera go-live readiness review
meeting.summary: Go-live readiness with Sylvera. Ines to schedule the analyst training session; Amara to finish the parity checks on the ratings dashboards; Sam to flip SSO to enforced.
action_items: Ines to schedule analyst training for Thursday next week
Amara to complete parity checks on the three ratings dashboards by Monday
Sam to enable SSO enforcement tomorrow
key_decisions: Go-live holds to the planned date if parity checks pass by Monday
meeting.notes: Go-live date unchanged. Only open risk is parity on the carbon-ratings dashboard.

transcript.speaker: Ines Ferreira
transcript.text: Two weeks to go-live, so let's walk the checklist. Amara, where are we on parity?

transcript.speaker: Amara Chen
transcript.text: Two of the three ratings dashboards match the old numbers exactly. The carbon-ratings one is off by a rounding step in one column.

transcript.speaker: Ines Ferreira
transcript.text: Is that a blocker or a known difference we can document?

transcript.speaker: Amara Chen
transcript.text: I think it's a known difference, but I want to prove it. I'll complete the parity checks on all three ratings dashboards by Monday and write up the rounding note.

transcript.speaker: Ines Ferreira
transcript.text: Great — if that lands Monday, the go-live date holds.

transcript.speaker: Sam Whitfield
transcript.text: On access: Okta SSO has been in test mode for a week, no login issues reported.

transcript.speaker: Amara Chen
transcript.text: None on our side either. IT is happy.

transcript.speaker: Sam Whitfield
transcript.text: Then I'll flip SSO to enforced tomorrow morning, so password logins stop working before the wider team gets invited.

transcript.speaker: Ines Ferreira
transcript.text: Good. Last piece is training. We promised a live session for the analyst team before launch.

transcript.speaker: Amara Chen
transcript.text: Thursday next week works best for the analysts — most of them are in the office that day.

transcript.speaker: Ines Ferreira
transcript.text: Then I'll schedule the analyst training session for Thursday next week and send the invite with the agenda today or tomorrow.

transcript.speaker: Amara Chen
transcript.text: Perfect. Should we also record it for the folks who can't make it?

transcript.speaker: Ines Ferreira
transcript.text: We always record, yes — that's part of the same session, not extra work.

transcript.speaker: Sam Whitfield
transcript.text: It might be worth considering a follow-up office hours slot after launch, but let's see how training goes first.

transcript.speaker: Ines Ferreira
transcript.text: Agreed, we'll decide after. Recap: parity from Amara by Monday, SSO enforced by Sam tomorrow, training invite from me for next Thursday.
